applicability: all staged source checkouts; languages with a CodeQL build-mode none extractor (cpp, csharp, java, javascript/typescript, python, ruby); Go and undetected languages are gaps

container_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit for one CodeQL language container (database create + analyze). A TIMEOUT is a coverage gap for that language (ADR-0013).
container_timeout_seconds.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_memory_bytes.description: Memory limit for the container (CodeQL, per language).
container_memory_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_cpu_millis.description: CPU quota (1000 = one core) (CodeQL, per language).
container_cpu_millis.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_pids.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_tmpfs_bytes.description: Size of the in-memory /tmp (CodeQL, per language).
container_tmpfs_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_stdout_limit_bytes.description: Captured stdout; beyond this the log is truncated (CodeQL, per language).
container_stdout_limit_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_stderr_limit_bytes.description: Captured stderr; beyond this the log is truncated (CodeQL, per language).
container_stderr_limit_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

codeql_threads.description: codeql --threads for database create and analyze; keep at or below container_cpu_millis / 1000.
codeql_threads.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

codeql_ram_bytes.description: codeql --ram (JVM and evaluator budget, passed in MiB); must stay below container_memory_bytes (CodeQL otherwise sizes itself from host memory and is OOM-killed).
codeql_ram_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.
